test_title: PYST 21: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Reasoning (Held On 10 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: In certain code language, TORCH is written as XOVGL and LEMON is written as PEQOR. How will MANDATE be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

 
• Code for consonants = positional value + 4
 
• Code for vowels = no change

TORCH is written as XOVGL 

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b6e026ee284a289dffb36debf89caff2a82f4a4cb10a15962e5704c4a5e5c9a9.png] 

And,

LEMON is written as PEQOR

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1759037858982a1978fccfedd92c7b292eedcb195fd6343ca878af11df669ae4.png] 

Similarly,

'MANDATE' = ?

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d46e82674d127d21d2726ae0563191d7a99a97b09f9214ea7801d596727c485.png] 

Hence, '**MANDATE**' is coded as "**QARHAXE**".
